content-locationText: Why are you passionate about coding? You can include some key traits like: analytical thinking, creativity, persistence and collaboration. A problem-solving mindset is always nice to have.
content-projectsAboutText: This app is a 2D jump-and-run minigame. The character, Pepe, moves through a side-scrolling level and must fend off crazed chickens. A larger boss enemy awaits at the end.
content-projectsAboutText2: This App is a Kanban Board App for Project Managing. You can Manage your Contacts and Tasks with it. In the Summary you can see all Tasks and the next Deadline
content-projectsExp-Text: This project was an individual learning project from the Developer Akademie. It was implemented using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with the help of a canvas board.
content-projectsExp-Text2: This was a learning project undertaken by a team of four from the Developer Akademie. It was built using Angular, Supabase, TypeScript, HTML, and SCSS. Within the team, my responsibilities included working on Supabase integration, contact details, informational pages Help/Legal Notice/Privacy Policy and summary.
content-projectsOrganized: How I have organized my work process
content-projectsOrganizedText: The project was planned and implemented using Trello, with tasks broken down into subtasks. The program structure was initially mapped out and subsequently expanded. The use of JavaScript classes ensures that the program logic remains organized and reusable.
content-projectsOrganizedText2: The project was planned and implemented using Trello, organized into three sprint phases. As a team, we coordinated daily on the tasks that still needed to be completed. Thanks to the Angular framework, the program code is structured into components, making it both well-organized and reusable.
